output.question: Where can I find Bank of America's latest annual report?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Bank of America's latest annual report is its 2025 Annual Report. You can find the reader-friendly PDF on the company's Investor Relations homepage at https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_299021e6298435f69aca9ed18a91ea2d/bankofamerica/db/867/10497/annual_report/BAC+2025+Annual+Report.pdf, or use the Annual Reports page at https://investor.bankofamerica.com/regulatory-and-other-filings/annual-reports, which lists the latest 10-K filed February 25, 2026 and provides PDF and HTML filing links.

key_facts.fact: Bank of America's Investor Relations homepage identifies the document as the '2025 Annual Report' and links directly to its PDF.
The Annual Reports page lists the latest filing as a 10-K dated 02/25/26, with the description 'Form 10-K: Annual report' and 314 pages.

The latest filing's direct HTML version is available at https://investor.bankofamerica.com/regulatory-and-other-filings/select-sec-filings/content/0000070858-26-000157/bac-20251231.htm, and its filing PDF is available at https://investor.bankofamerica.com/regulatory-and-other-filings/select-sec-filings/content/0000070858-26-000157/0000070858-26-000157.pdf.
